accountBalance.description: List of balances for the account, for example regular postpaid balance, deposit balance, write-off balance.

accountRelationship.description: List of balances related to the account. For example a list of billing accounts that contribute to a financial account

accountType.description: A categorization of an account, such as individual, joint, and so forth, whose instances share some of the same characteristics. Note: for flexibility we use a String here but an implementation may use an enumeration with a limited list of valid values.

contact.description: List of people who could be contacted regarding the account, for example the accountant who authorizes payments

lastUpdate.description: The date and time that the account was last updated

relatedParty.description: List of parties that have some relationship with the account, for example the customer to whom the account belongs

state.description: Contains the lifecycle state such as: Active, Closed, Suspended and so on.

taxExemption.description: List of tax exemptions that can be applied when calculating charges levied to the account.

description.description: A narrative text describing the content of the attachment

mimeType.description: a technical characterization of the attachment content format using IETF Mime Types

url.description: Uniform Resource Locator, is a web page address (a subset of URI)

billingPeriod.description: A billing time period. It can be recurring, for example: week, month, quarter of year, year .

chargeDateOffset.description: An offset of a date through which charges previously received by the billing system will appear on the bill. The offset is expressed as number of days with regard to the start of the BillingPeriod.

creditDateOffset.description: An offset of a date through which credits previously received by the billing system will appear on the bill. The offset is expressed as number of days with regard to the start of the BillingPeriod.

description.description: An explanation regarding this billing cycle specification

frequency.description: Frequency of the billing cycle (monthly for instance)

mailingDateOffset.description: An offset of a customer bill mailing date. The offset is expressed as number of days with regard to the start of the BillingPeriod.

paymentDueDateOffset.description: An offset of a payment due date. The offset is expressed as number of days with regard to the start of the BillingPeriod.

allOf.description: An individual or an organization used as a contact point for a given account and accessed via some contact medium.

contactName.description: A displayable name for that contact

id.description: Identifier of the contact within list of the contacts (for entities with list)

partyRoleType.description: Identifies what kind of party role type is linked to the contact (a account manager...)

preferred.description: If true, indicates that is the preferred contact medium

href.description: The URI of the referred entity.

id.description: The identifier of the referred entity.

Extensible.description: Base Extensible schema for use in TMForum Open-APIs - When used for in a schema it means that the Entity described by the schema  MUST be extended with the @type

A financial (account receivable account/account payable) aggregates the amounts of one or more party accounts (billing or settlement) owned by a given party. It is a specialization of entity Account.

FinancialAccountRef.description: AccountReceivable reference. An account of money owed by a party to another entity in exchange for goods or services that have been delivered or used. paymentStatus.description: The condition of the account, such as due, paid, in arrears.

SettlementAccount.description: A party account used for settlement purposes. It includes a description of the bill structure (frequency, presentation media, format and so on). It is a specialization of entity PartyAccount.

allOf.description: Reference of a tax definition. A tax is levied by an authorized tax jurisdiction. For example, there are many different types of tax (Federal Tax levied by the US Government, State Tax levied by the State of California, City Tax levied by the City of Los Angeles, etc.).

jurisdictionLevel.description: Level of the jurisdiction that levies the tax

jurisdictionName.description: Name of the jurisdiction that levies the tax

allOf.description: A tax exemption certificate represents a tax exemption granted to a party (individual or organization) by a tax jurisdiction which may be a city, state, country,... An exemption has a certificate identifier (received from the jurisdiction that levied the tax) and a validity period. An exemption is per tax types and determines for each type of tax what portion of the tax is exempted (partial by percentage or complete) via the tax definition.

certificateNumber.description: Identifier of a document that shows proof of exemption from taxes for the taxing jurisdiction

id.description: Identifier of the tax exemption within list of the exemptions

issuingJurisdiction.description: Name of the jurisdiction that issued the exemption

taxDefinition.description: A list of taxes that are covered by the exemption, e.g. City Tax, State Tax. The definition would include the exemption (e.g. for a rate exemption 0% would be a full exemption, 5% could be a partial exemption if the actual rate was 10%).

TimePeriod.description: A period of time, either as a deadline (endDateTime only) a startDateTime only, or both

endDateTime.description: End of the time period, using IETC-RFC-3339 format

startDateTime.description: Start of the time period, using IETC-RFC-3339 format
